name: vue-mail-designer
description: Visual email builder with drag & drop functionality using Vue 3 + Vuemail

scripts.build: pnpm --filter email-builder run build && pnpm --filter demo run build
scripts.check: pnpm --filter email-builder run check && pnpm --filter demo run check
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter email-builder run lint && pnpm --filter demo run lint
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter email-builder run typecheck && pnpm --filter demo run typecheck
